message: Important correction from operator: DO NOT enforce self-inbox identity, create conversation/session bindings, add authorization checks, or block cross-agent agent_inbox calls. Agents are not adversarial; this is an innocent tool-selection clarity issue. I revised your canonical assigned task (now [P2] Clarify self-inbox activation versus read-only agent observation, task version 3, spec version 2). Adopt/read the latest pinned task spec before starting work. Audit actual MCP descriptions/ReadOnly annotations/capability catalog/AGENTS.md and align guidance: agent_inbox is an activity-producing self-inbox that may Ready->Working; observe_agent is a side-effect-free cross-agent read. Avoid gratuitous renames, protocol changes and duplicate tests; 3.63 already implements most of this. Prefer minimal corrections and independent review. Original enforcement instructions are superseded.
